Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, the One who humiliates every tyrant
And the One who honors the believers
You are my refuge when all paths exhaust me
And You are the Creator of my being, out of mercy for me
And You were free from any need to create me
And if not for Your mercy, I would be among the perished ones
And You are my supporter with victory over my enemies

Arabic text: وَلَوْلَا نَصْرُكَ إِيَّايَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَفْضُوحِيْنَ
Translation: And if not for Your help to me, I would be among the disgraced ones
O the One who sends mercy from its sources
And who originates blessings from their places

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ خَصَّ نَفْسَهُ بِالشُّمُوخِ وَالرِّفْعَةِ
Translation: O the One who has distinguished Himself with loftiness and elevation
So His friends are honored by His honor

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ وَضَعَتْ لَهُ الْمُلُوكُ نِيرَ الْمَذَلَّةِ عَلٰى أَعْنَاقِهِمْ
Translation: And O the One before whom kings place the yoke of humility on their necks
So they are fearful of His power

Arabic text: أَسْأَلُكَ بِكَيْنُونِيَّتِكَ الَّتِيْ اشْتَقَقْتَهَا مِنْ كِبْرِيَائِكَ
Translation: I ask You by Your essence which You derived from Your greatness

Arabic text: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِكِبْرِيَائِكَ الَّتِيْ اشْتَقَقْتَهَا مِنْ عِزَّتِكَ
Translation: And I ask You by Your greatness which You derived from Your might

Arabic text: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِعِزَّتِكَ الَّتِيْ اسْتَوَيْتَ بِهَا عَلٰى عَرْشِكَ
Translation: And I ask You by Your might by which You established Yourself on Your throne
And by which You created all Your creation
So they are submissive to You

Arabic text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
Translation: That You send blessings upon Muhammad and his household
